title: Goraasa
description: Goraasa is a Sudan classic prepared with all-purpose flour, instant yeast. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Cover the batter loosely and leave in a suitable warm, clean place for about 60 minutes to become bubbly and lightly tangy; do not refrigerate during active fermentation.
Swirl thin layers of batter in a lightly greased hot pan. Cook both sides, about 20 minutes per batch, to make flexible crepes.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
